title: Morning Brief — Wednesday, 4 November 2026
description: The TGA approves a daily oral tablet form of Wegovy, Queensland's $18.4 billion Borumba pumped hydro project remains on hold pending a business case review, and a Gold Coast food waste composting program posts modest but growing diversion rates. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
